_concepto: Video ambiente de ~60 s que se repite en bucle, para una pista lo-fi. Un solo escenario: un cuarto de estudio de noche con una ventana grande bajo la lluvia, lámpara cálida, taza humeante, tocadiscos girando, plantas en el alféizar y un gato dormido. Sin gente, sin texto. Doce encuadres del mismo cuarto, cámara fija, un solo elemento en movimiento lento por plano. El bucle se cierra en el corte: P12 (detalle) corta a P01 (general) como cualquier otro corte. Clips de 5,17 s; el máster usa 5,0 de cada uno.
_reglas_del_cuarto: Planta fija para que los doce dibujos coincidan: ventana grande en la pared del fondo; escritorio de madera bajo la ventana; lámpara de bronce con pantalla de vidrio verde en la esquina IZQUIERDA del escritorio; taza de cerámica y cuaderno abierto a la DERECHA; tocadiscos sobre una repisa baja a la IZQUIERDA del escritorio; alféizar ancho a la DERECHA con una manta de lana bordó doblada (el lugar del gato) y dos plantas en maceta; sillón en primer término a la derecha; alfombra; biblioteca en la pared izquierda; auriculares sobre el escritorio junto al cuaderno.
estilo_imagen: Hand-painted 2D animation background art for a calm night-time lo-fi music video: soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain, warm amber interior light against a cool blue-violet rainy night outside the window. Muted but rich palette: amber, teal, dusty violet, burgundy accents. Clean readable shapes, soft edges, no heavy outlines. Everything is still and cosy. Rain streaks the glass; the distant city is only soft blurred discs of coloured light. Any neon outside is an abstract blurred colour shape with NO letters and NO readable characters. No people anywhere in the picture. The painting fills the ENTIRE 16:9 canvas from edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no cinemascope strip, no borders or frames of any kind.
medio: hand-painted 2D animated film with soft painterly textures, calm, slow and quiet

gato.descripcion: a plump grey tabby cat with darker grey stripes, a white chest and white paws, curled up ASLEEP on the folded burgundy wool blanket on the wide windowsill, eyes closed, tail wrapped over its paws; it never wakes up, never stands, never looks at the camera

cuarto.descripcion: the small study room at night: a big rain-streaked window on the back wall, a wooden desk under it, a brass desk lamp with a green glass shade at the left corner of the desk, a ceramic mug and an open notebook at the right, a record player on a low shelf to the left of the desk, a wide windowsill on the right with a folded burgundy blanket and two potted plants, an armchair in the right foreground, a rug, a bookshelf on the left wall

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE DEL BUCLE. El cuarto entero desde la puerta: la ventana con lluvia, la lámpara, el gato dormido. Es a donde vuelve P12.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT of the whole study room from the doorway at the back of the room, camera at standing eye level, the SAME view as the reference location picture. The big rain-streaked window fills the far wall; under it the desk with the brass lamp with its GREEN glass shade at the left corner, and the mug, the open notebook and the headphones at the right; the record player on its low shelf to the left of the desk; the wide windowsill on the right with the folded burgundy blanket and the potted plants; the armchair in the right foreground and the rug. The cat is curled up asleep ON THE BLANKET ON THE WINDOWSILL, not on the desk. Outside, blurred city lights under the rain. A plain wooden desk chair stands tucked under the desk, its back toward the camera, empty. Nobody is in the room.
planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA on a tripod, perfectly still for the whole shot. Only tiny slow ambient motion: rain streaks slide down the window glass, a thin thread of vapour rises from the mug, the sleeping cat's flank rises and falls slowly, the record on the turntable turns slowly, the blurred lights outside shimmer faintly. The lamp light is steady. Nothing else moves. The room stays empty; the wooden chair stays tucked under the desk exactly where it is; the only thing beyond the glass is the dark rainy city with its blurred lights. The rain keeps falling on the window glass for the whole shot, and it stays night outside: the same dark rainy city, the same blurred lights.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are a steady soft rain pattering on the window glass, a faint far-away muffled city hum.
